source: Saved final meshes and cached unperforated crown; independent checks do not invoke the geometry generator

triangular_profiles.limits: Metadata profiles describe cutters, not a count of final independent physical openings.

base_actual_section.method: Smallest actual closed BODY mesh section loop containing each intended hole centre; full area and boundary comparison detects filled holes or merger with a neighbouring/function opening at this section.
base_actual_section.limits: Proves base aperture profiles only at Z1.8; does not claim all heights are identical or count all openings globally.

roof_actual_apertures.method: Final BODY and cached mother-crown vertical rays: four internal probes plus twelve probes on a ring 0.35 mm outside every roof triangle.
roof_actual_apertures.limits: Checks sampled skin openings and surrounding rim continuity. Finite ring probes cannot prove global hole independence, minimum web thickness at every location, or complete unobstructed sight through all internal mechanisms. Cutter-profile count is not reported as the actual independent aperture count.

main_key_surface.method: Compare saved main-key topmost mesh hits with the saved unperforated mother crown on a 9 x 11 inset grid for each 23 x 27 mm touch face.
main_key_surface.limits: Proves sampled outer-height agreement and catches a raised plate. Does not prove physical click force, cap thickness or every boundary point.

rear_crown_profile.method: Actual saved unperforated crown centreline against the specified single-span Hermite rear; checks monotone descent and bounded local slope changes.
rear_crown_profile.scope: Crown centreline only, D45..89. No claim of mathematical C2 continuity of an STL tessellation or of every off-centre section.

verification_scope: metadata plus actual base cross-sections, sampled roof rim/openings, sampled key heights and rear crown
limits: No physical print, force, friction, strength or fatigue test. These checks do not certify a global minimum thickness or count final independent apertures from cutter metadata.
